selectionPolicy.winQualificationRule: Documented current form and today's specific surface/going/trip plus at least one of class and rivals; at least one supporting factor and independent source. Moderate downside allowed but disclosed. No odds-driven confidence.
selectionPolicy.rationale: Prioritize repeatable race-specific performances and oppose unproved surface/trip changes; do not prohibit well-backed runners for price-based race confidence. Avoid odds-on as a separate paper-selection value policy.

modelAccuracyDevelopment.status: SHADOW_TEST — process improvement, not validated predictive uplift
ruleChanges: Confirm specific course, distance, going and surface of every referenced historical win; avoid past Ice Show and Criminal Shore trip-assumption mistakes.
Separate WIN suitability from EW top-three competitiveness: Donnie Azoff was second while removed horses Dashing Dick/Fenlander/Notimetotakeoff placed.
Penalise untested jumps in trip and surface when selecting WIN: Green Falcon's first 2m and Charles Morin's disappointing Tapeta debut illustrate need for evidence.
Build a named-opposition review, particularly improving rivals, not just own form: Oviedo lost as 2/1 favourite.
Evaluate first-run-after-absence and rest days as fitness risks, rather than treating old winning marks as proof of current ability.
Keep bookmaker prices outside race-confidence classification; apply prices only to independent value checks after ability scoring.
Log pre-race evidence, official going and early quote timestamps to enable future honest out-of-sample calibration.

recentResultsLearning.note: Prospectively frozen 14 October selections preserved, analysis updated AFTER results; these are not proven model improvements.
observations: Green Falcon won the 2m Nottingham Colwick Cup by 2¾ lengths, a successful first attempt at 2m. Novel-trip uncertainty should be assessed separately from actual fitness and demonstrated stamina cues rather than serving as an automatic exclusion.
Green Falcon's official 5/2 JF SP is shorter than the originally recorded 13/2 research quote. Preserve 13/2 for simulated paper BOG pricing rather than replace with SP.
Magic Box runner-up at reported 14/1 compared with saved early 6/1. Under ¼-odds top-three hypothetical terms, a £5 place leg returns £22.50; verify the official placing when accessible.

Guard Your Dreams pulled up on ground that was officially changed to soft after Race 1 at Ffos Las. The seasonal absence and adverse going change support stronger day-of ground monitoring for first-run-after-break selections, without drawing a categorical conclusion from one result.
Viroflay was a non-runner and must refund the £10 paper WIN stake; it is excluded from the win strike-rate denominator.

Seeyainthesuninn was reported winner at Wetherby 16:20 despite concerns about faster good-to-firm going; its recently proven three-mile trip and race fitness were the evidence-led positives. This single outcome should not erase the going concern in future analysis.
Forever Glamorous was declared a non-runner for Nottingham 17:22 and the paper each-way stake is fully refunded. Exclude NR from both win and each-way performance denominators.

Centurion's Sister won the 16:52 Wetherby as 13/8 favourite after an August maiden hurdle win, confirming that sustained place form and intermediate trip suitability can identify a contender; one result does not prove model uplift.
